reference.derivation: Prototype TestCatalogue T16, revised in #39: the Basel cap uses the collateral of the same netting set without a margin agreement, NICA only (CRE52.2, CRE52.10), so posted VM leaves the cap and the cap binds as under CRR (T17). Hand calculation: V = -1.1bn, C on the cap basis = 0, RC = 0; IR add-on = 0.5% x 5,845m x SD, SD = (1 - exp(-0.05 x 3650/365)) / 0.05 for a swap ending 2036-09-27, = 229,982,829.40; multiplier = 0.05 + 0.95 x exp(-1.1bn / (2 x 0.95 x 229,982,829.40)) = 0.12664; EAD = 1.4 x 0.12664 x 229,982,829.40 = 40,774,849.35, below the margined EAD of 376,592,788.35. Engineering scenario, not authoritative.
Cap applied flag of the T16 scenario: the cap on the NICA basis, 40,774,849.35, is below the margined EAD, 376,592,788.35. Engineering scenario, not authoritative.
